offering_description.value: Develops and sells specialty chemistry and data analytics for oil and gas well completion and production. Customers are oil and gas operators and oilfield service companies, served through blended chemical products and field services.

primary_products.value: well completion chemicals; production chemicals; friction reducers; drilling fluid additives

primary_services.value: on-site chemical blending; field technical support; well data analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators, oilfield service companies

revenue_model.value: product sales: chemical products sold to well operators and service companies; service fees: on-site blending, field support and well data services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: formulates and blends chemicals from purchased raw materials, sold to oilfield operators; service provider: delivers chemical application and field services at well sites for energy producers; software / platform: provides data analytics for well performance, sold to operators and service firms
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: US national: Permian Basin, Eagle Ford, Marcellus and other major US oil and gas basins

specialization.value: related lines: oilfield chemistry products, field chemical services and well data analytics sold to the same energy customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to oil and gas operators and service companies; own locations: chemical blending and storage facilities serving basins across the US

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, chemical handling and hazardous materials transport rules, mainly EPA and state oil and gas regulators

notes: Current segment mix and recent divestitures, and the consumer and industrial chemical lines, are uncertain in my knowledge, so verify the present product and service scope.
